writeup: TIC 468210292 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.890154 days and a primary eclipse depth of 7.54 percent. The binary was identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry using the Box Least Squares periodogram method, which detected a signal-to-noise ratio of 140.9. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at a peak signal-to-noise of 64.8, with a centroid offset of 1.4 arcsec from the target position. A secondary eclipse was not detected. The target does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate. One open question remains: the eclipse depths alternate significantly in a pattern suggesting the true period is twice the initially detected value, which is why the corrected period of 2.890154 days is reported here.
